name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 2 – Am 49
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 2a. Recalls, that a bombshell report revealed the European Commission’s brazen misuse of taxpayer funds, funnelling billions into a shadowy network of NGOs and think tanks to promote its own political agenda and silence dissenting voices; condemns this enormous EU-NGO propaganda complex, which undermines democracy and constitutes a massive betrayal of European citizens;
